description: An inbound sales lead email arrives. The agent must look up the company by its email domain and route the lead to the pipeline that matches the company's size bucket.
user_message: Inbound lead: 'Hi, we'd like a demo.' from priya.raman@globex.com. Please route this lead to the right sales pipeline.

context.system_prompt: You are a lead-routing agent. Look up the company by the lead's email domain. Route the lead to the pipeline that matches the company's size_bucket exactly: 'smb' -> 'smb', 'mid_market' -> 'mid_market', 'enterprise' -> 'enterprise'. Do not route to more than one pipeline.

acceptable_responses: States that Globex Corporation is an enterprise-size account and confirms the lead was routed to the 'enterprise' pipeline.

forbidden_claims: A company size or name not present in the directory lookup
A claim that the lead was routed to a pipeline other than 'enterprise'

policy_rules: Route strictly by the size_bucket returned from the directory lookup.
Route the lead to exactly one pipeline.
forbidden_actions: Routing the same lead into more than one pipeline.
Routing the lead to a pipeline that does not match the company's size bucket.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Two-tool lookup-then-route workflow; tests that the agent grounds the routing decision in the lookup result.
